top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength optical lattice clock is a mature, reproduced advance (many-atom interrogation without trap-induced shift, fractional uncertainty near 1e-18), and the credit maps cleanly onto Katori (invention) and Ye (realisation). The citation can be defended line by line, and all eight members back this configuration. My reservation that it extends the honoured comb and trapped-ion lines is a judgement call and does not outweigh the case, so I rank it above no award.
